review.why: Designs and uses n8n's built-in Data Tables: schemas, operations, dedup and lookups, with the quirks that cause silent NULL columns.
review.summary: Explains system columns, primitive-only types with a suffix for stored objects, camelCase naming and relational design without foreign keys. It compares insert, upsert, update, get and delete, gives patterns for dedup, lookup tables and audit trails, and a verification checklist. Anti-patterns include writing system columns and using Data Tables for critical data.
strengths: Says when Remove Duplicates is the better choice
Verification steps catch silent NULL columns
Clear limit: not a system of record or for millions of rows
cautions: Includes temporary workaround notes for a UI quirk
Three reference files are not read here
